mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for three consecutive months, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 600 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 600, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate above 5.0% consistently signals weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's delayed response to inflation erodes real corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, it indicates a policy error that fails to control inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
